summary: This is a routine 8-K filing by South Plains Financial, Inc. announcing its second quarter 2026 financial results, an earnings conference call, and a regular quarterly dividend of $0.18 per share. No special situation such as a merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private transaction, spinoff, or restructuring is present. The filings under Items 2.02 and 7.01 are furnished not filed, and the dividend declaration under Item 8.01 is a standard recurring event. The registrant is the issuer; there are no actionable event-driven or risk-arbitrage angles.
